addons.name: Word Timing (English)
addons.description: Pins every transcribed English word to the moment it was spoken, so cuts land between words instead of inside them.
addons.details: wav2vec2-base-960h (Facebook AI, fine-tuned on LibriSpeech) as a character CTC model, 8-bit quantized ONNX export by Xenova. Drift force-aligns Whisper's words against it to get real word start and end times for transcript-driven cutting and word-accurate captions. Package id: align.wav2vec2-en.
addons.author: CutWire

addons.name: Essential Audio Effects
addons.description: EQ, compressor, noise gate, and more to clean up sound, plus fun voice changers, echo, telephone, radio, and vinyl effects.
addons.details: Native audio effect graph: EQ, compressor, limiter, noise gate, de-esser, voice leveler, plus voice changers, telephone/radio filters, bitcrush, vinyl, echo and chorus. Package id: audioeffects.core.
addons.author: CutWire

addons.name: Noise Removal
addons.description: Cleans up background hiss, hum, and room noise while keeping the voice clear. Used by Remove noise.
addons.details: DeepFilterNet3 full-band 48 kHz speech enhancement in ONNX. Used by Remove noise. Package id: deepfilternet.v3.
addons.author: CutWire

addons.name: Depth (3D Lighting & Focus)
addons.description: Works out how far away everything in a video is, so you can add lights that fall on the scene, realistic background blur, fog, and titles that sit behind people.
addons.details: Video Depth Anything Small in ONNX: a DINOv2 ViT-S encoder run per frame and a temporal DPT head run per 32-frame window, which keeps depth steady from frame to frame instead of flickering. Outputs relative inverse depth. Ships fp32 and fp16 weights; fp32 is used unless a GPU execution provider is active. Package id: depth.vda-small.
addons.author: CutWire

addons.name: Speaker Labels
addons.description: Tells who is speaking when, so interviews and conversations come out with each line labelled by speaker.
addons.details: pyannote segmentation-3.0 finds active speakers in overlapping 10 s windows and 3D-Speaker ERes2Net fingerprints each voice; Drift clusters the fingerprints to match voices across the whole recording. The ONNX exports are the ones published by sherpa-onnx. Package id: diarize.pyannote-eres2net.
addons.author: CutWire

addons.name: Essential Video Effects
addons.description: Colour fixes, blurs, glow, glitch, green screen, warps, beauty makeup, grading tools, 3D relighting and depth of field, and more — the everyday effects for cleaning up and styling clips.
addons.details: GPU shader effect library (GLSL). Colour adjustment (exposure, highlights/shadows/whites/blacks, vibrance, green/magenta tint, HSL hue/sat/luma), blurs, glitch, glow, stylise, chroma key / green screen, face warps, face swap, 3D face mesh, Face Retouch (skin smoothing, whitening, slim face, big eyes, lipstick and blush, ported from GPUPixel) plus eye, brow and teeth makeup, depth effects (3D relight, depth of field, depth fog, depth view, behind-subject placement; these need the Depth addon), plus addon-only warps, light rays, CDL/levels, grain and weather overlays. Package id: effects.core.
addons.author: CutWire

addons.name: Trending Effects
addons.description: Looks made for short-form edits: sparkle, beat shake, kaleidoscope, lightning, clones, cutouts, and ready-made effect templates.
addons.details: Short-form GPU looks plus 23 beat-synced effect templates: sparkle, halation, beat shake, kaleidoscope, lightning, cutout stacks, clones. Package ids: effects.trending.
addons.author: CutWire

addons.name: Funny Face Effects
addons.description: Finds faces in your clip so funny face warps can follow them as people move.
addons.details: MediaPipe face mesh plus the YuNet detector, in ONNX. Scans a clip once so Funny Face warps can follow landmarks frame to frame. Package id: face.landmark.
addons.author: CutWire

addons.name: Essential Fonts
addons.description: 21 fonts for titles, captions, and body text — bold display styles, clean sans, editorial serifs, and playful options.
addons.details: 21 OFL/UFL font families across display, clean, editorial and playful categories. Package id: fonts.essentials.
addons.author: CutWire

addons.name: Scene Labels
addons.description: Works out what is in each shot — people, animals, vehicles and everyday objects — so you can find the moments you want.
addons.details: YOLOX-Tiny object detection in ONNX, COCO's 80 everyday classes. Drift samples a few frames of each detected shot and labels it, so scenes can be searched and ranked by what is in them. Package id: object.yolox-tiny.
addons.author: CutWire

addons.name: AI Engine — Any phone
addons.description: Powers auto captions, subject cutout, funny face effects, and noise removal. Runs on your phone's processor — there is nothing else to choose.
addons.details: Complete ONNX Runtime build that Drift dlopens for AI features. Runs on the CPU execution provider: NNAPI and XNNPACK are compiled into this build, but Drift does not request either yet. Upstream: Microsoft ONNX Runtime 1.27.0, the onnxruntime-android AAR from Maven Central. Platform: android-arm64.

addons.description: Powers auto captions, subject cutout, funny face effects, and noise removal. Works on every computer — install this first unless you know you want a faster graphics option.
addons.details: Complete ONNX Runtime build that Drift dlopens for AI features. Ships the CPU execution provider only. Upstream: Microsoft ONNX Runtime 1.27.0. Platform: linux-x64.

addons.description: Same AI features, sped up by an NVIDIA graphics card. Needs NVIDIA driver 580 or newer; CUDA and cuDNN are included. Falls back to this computer if the card can't be used.
addons.details: Complete ONNX Runtime build with the CUDA execution provider. CUDA 13 and cuDNN 9 runtimes are bundled — not the full CUDA Toolkit. The host still needs a recent NVIDIA driver (Linux ≥ 580.65 for CUDA 13.0). Falls back to CPU when the device cannot be used. addons.name: Enhance Video Models
addons.description: Upscalers for anime, live action and 3D animation, plus a clean-up model that removes compression and noise.
addons.details: Fifteen single-image models run frame by frame on ONNX Runtime: 2x and 4x upscalers for anime and drawings (Adore, Ani4K v2, Balanced, Strong v1.5/v2.5/v3, Real-ESRGAN Anime Video), live action and 3D renders (LiveAction V1, OpenProteus, NomosUni, ClearReality V1, Nomos8k Strong), a general Real-ESRGAN 4x, and GaterV3 for compression clean-up without resizing. Licenses vary by model, including non-commercial ones; see NOTICE.txt. Package id: restore.models.
addons.author: CutWire
addons.license: Mixed: CC-BY-4.0, CC-BY-NC-4.0, CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0, BSD-3-Clause, unknown (see NOTICE.txt)

addons.name: People Cutout
addons.description: Cuts people out from the background automatically, with no clicking — soft edges that keep hair looking natural.
addons.details: Robust Video Matting, MobileNetV3 backbone, in ONNX. Recurrent human matting: no prompt, soft alpha rather than a hard mask, and a colour-decontaminated foreground that removes background spill from hair. Ships fp32 and fp16 weights; fp32 is used unless an execution provider is chosen by name. Package id: rvm.mobilenetv3.
addons.author: CutWire

addons.name: People Cutout — Best Quality
addons.description: A larger, slower people cutout with cleaner edges on difficult shots. Install People Cutout first — this is the same thing, only heavier.
addons.details: Robust Video Matting, ResNet-50 backbone, in ONNX. Same recurrent human matting as the MobileNetV3 pack with tighter edges on fine hair and motion blur, at roughly twice the processing time and five times the download. Both can be installed together and picked between in the cutout window. Package id: rvm.resnet50.
addons.author: CutWire

addons.name: Subject Cutout
addons.description: Lets you click a person or object and cut it out from the background across a whole clip.
addons.details: Meta SAM 2.1 tiny, full video pipeline in ONNX. Powers subject segmentation and tracking across a clip. Package id: sam2.tiny.
addons.author: CutWire

addons.name: Speech Detection
addons.description: Finds exactly where people are talking, so silence removal skips breaths, music and room noise instead of cutting them as speech.
addons.details: Silero VAD v5 in ONNX: one speech probability every 32 ms of 16 kHz audio. Used by Detect / Remove Silence with the voice-activity method and to tighten transcript word timings. Package id: silero.vad.
addons.author: CutWire

addons.name: Emoji Stickers
addons.description: Colour emoji stickers — smileys, hearts, hands, animals, food, and more — ready to drop onto your timeline.
addons.details: Colour emoji stickers extracted from HarmonyOS Sans, plus the emoji font so the picker can reach every glyph. License: Proprietary — HarmonyOS Sans. Package id: stickers.harmonyos.
addons.author: CutWire

addons.name: Essential Transitions
addons.description: Fades, wipes, slides, zooms, page turns, and over a hundred other ways to move between clips.
addons.details: GPU transition shaders: fades, wipes, slides, zooms, distortions, page turn, cube flip, energy burst, prism wipe, plus the gl-transitions collection — glitch, warp, kaleidoscope, film burn, water drop and more. Package id: transitions.core.
addons.author: CutWire

addons.name: Text to Speech
addons.description: Natural voiceovers in 21 languages, and clone a voice from a short sample.
addons.details: Chatterbox Multilingual by Resemble AI (MIT), exported to ONNX by onnx-community. Drift speaks text in 21 languages with a q4-quantized language model, and can match a reference voice from a short recording. Package id: tts.chatterbox-multilingual.
addons.author: CutWire

addons.name: Auto Captions
addons.description: Turns speech into subtitle captions in many languages. Used by Create captions from speech.
addons.details: OpenAI Whisper small, fp16 ONNX. Automatic speech recognition used by Create captions from speech — about 99 languages. Package id: whisper.small.
